title: ShotFinder: Imagination-Driven Open-Domain Video Shot Retrieval via Web Search
abstract: arXiv:2601.23232v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In recent years, large language models (LLMs) have made rapid progress in information retrieval, yet existing research has mainly focused on text or static multimodal settings. Open-domain video shot retrieval, which involves richer temporal structure and more complex semantics, still lacks systematic benchmarks and analysis. To fill this gap, we introduce ShotFinder, a benchmark that formalizes editing requirements as keyframe-oriented shot descriptions and introduces five types of controllable single-factor constraints: Temporal order, Color, Visual style, Audio, and Resolution. translated_title: ShotFinder：基于网络搜索的想象力驱动开放域视频镜头检索
translated_abstract: 近年来，大型语言模型（LLMs）在信息检索领域取得了快速进展，但现有研究主要集中在文本或静态多模态设置上。开放域视频镜头检索涉及更丰富的时序结构和更复杂的语义，但仍缺乏系统性的基准和分析。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了ShotFinder，一个将编辑需求形式化为面向关键帧的镜头描述的基准，并引入了五种可控单因素约束：时序顺序、颜色、视觉风格、音频和分辨率。我们从YouTube上20个主题类别中精选了1,210个高质量样本，采用大模型生成并结合人工验证。基于该基准，我们提出了ShotFinder，一个文本驱动的三阶段检索与定位流程：（1）通过视频想象力进行查询扩展，（2）利用搜索引擎检索候选视频，（3）
tldr: 该论文提出了ShotFinder基准与三阶段检索流程，通过想象力驱动的查询扩展和网络搜索实现开放域视频镜头检索，并引入时序、颜色、视觉风格、音频和分辨率五种可控单因素约束来形式化视频编辑需求。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ShotFinder, a benchmark and text-driven three-stage retrieval pipeline that enables open-domain video shot retrieval via web search, featuring imagination-driven query expansion and five controllable single-factor constraints (temporal order, color, visual style, audio, and resolution) to formalize editing requirements.
